2024 is a leap year, but 1638 is not.  
252 days from 02-20-1638:  
February has 28 days in 1638 → 8 days left in Feb (20th to 28th inclusive = 9 days? Let's count: 20–28 → 9 days, so 252 - 9 = 243 left).  
March (31) + April (30) + May (31) + June (30) + July (31) + August (31) + September (30) = 214 days used.  
243 - 214 = 29 days left → into October → October 29, 1638.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1638-10-29
